title: Whispers Of Yesterday Review · Nov 18 (1 extra story)
subtitle: One extra story for Wed Nov 18, 5:06 PM · T2 vintage photo, no people · approved by Scott in chat

stories.quote: MOM WASHED HER HAIR IN RAIN BARREL WATER, AND SWORE NOTHING ELSE MADE IT SHINE.
stories.alt: Vintage-style color photo of a weathered wooden rain barrel with iron hoops beside a farmhouse back door, with a tin dipper hanging on its rim, a galvanized wash basin and a flour-sack towel on a wooden crate beside it. Text at the top reads: Mom washed her hair in rain barrel water, and swore nothing else made it shine.
